purpose: Record one owner-operated Windows play session without inventing results, separate build capability from human discovery, and route evidence to the smallest justified next decision.

rules: Use exactly one locale per human session and never switch mid-session when comparing comprehension.
Run Korean first for the canonical meaning and comedy-tone read.
Record English as a separate human language check.
Never collect fun, comedy, or comprehension ratings from qps-long; it is QA-only for expansion, fallback, glyph, and clipping checks.
Do not count automation as a human session or average its results with human ratings.
Do not count owner selftest as naive first-user discovery evidence.
Automation may corroborate a deterministic state or build baseline only when labeled separately.
Keyboard/mouse and physical gamepad results use separate session records; a mid-session device switch invalidates device comparison.

sourceCapabilityAudit.humanRecordingRule: Preflight the actual EXE. If direct-slot preview is absent, mark DIRECT_SLOT_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_BUILD and do not score its 90-second miss as player confusion; still record the actual entry path and time.

invalidForBalanceWhen: Day 3 or Day 4 settlement produces Deadline
Day 5 incomplete settlement does not produce Deadline
signal stage 2 does not produce immediate Rescued

session.earlyEnd: Stop gameplay at RESCUED, EXHAUSTED, DEADLINE, player request, crash, or hard/soft lock; record the first applicable outcome and elapsed time.
setup: Record build commit, Windows EXE SHA-256, executable name, resolution, window mode, locale, evidence type, and input device before play.
Start a new game without grant, warp, debug console, solution notes, or developer overlay.
Confirm DAY 1/5 before recording a five-day balance session; otherwise record only a build-capability defect.
Use Korean for the primary owner session; run English as a separate session when checking language.
Use keyboard/mouse or one physical gamepad for the entire session.

observerWindows.focus: first movement, nearby interaction, actual module entry capability and path
facility approach, departure, land gathering, first resource choice
swim entry/search/return and first camp return
crafting, research, valid placement, bag upgrade seen/bought/skipped
room preview/commit attempt, rescue signal progress, rescue or failure

session.windowRule: Observer windows are note-taking prompts, not player instructions or mandatory order. Record each milestone at its first actual occurrence.

milestones.definition: First facility proximity prompt caused by direct approach.
First facility popup opened and one facility-owned action attempted.
First land resource added to the bag.
Enter water, search at least one water node, and return to land.
First return that transfers bag resources to camp storage.
First recipe research or crafted tool completed.
First general facility committed at a valid site and still directly approachable.
Bag 4-to-6 upgrade cost is seen and the player buys, postpones, or rejects it.
Room preview opens through the actual build path and at least one candidate is visible.
One room confirm is attempted; record exact success or failure reason and whether W2/D1 changed.
RESCUED, EXHAUSTED, DEADLINE, TIMEOUT, PLAYER_STOP, CRASH, or SOFTLOCK.

classificationRules: If no direct-slot target or prompt exists in the EXE, use DIRECT_SLOT_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_BUILD; do not mark MODULE_SLOT_NEAR as player-failed.
If direct-slot entry exists but the owner selftest does not find it, record an owner diagnostic miss but do not count it as naive discovery evidence.
If storage planning opens preview, record STORAGE_PLANNING and its time even when direct-slot eligibility is false.
If an expected interaction exists but input, focus, or state prevents use, mark TECHNICALLY_BLOCKED and triage the technical defect.

anchors.1: No desire to continue; choices felt empty.
anchors.3: Playable with at least one meaningful choice or satisfying moment.
anchors.5: Strong desire to continue or retry; the loop produced clear tension and payoff.

anchors.1: Next action and feedback were clear.
anchors.5: Repeatedly unable to tell what action, place, cost, or result meant.

anchors.3: Stopped for 30 to 60 seconds but recovered without a shortcut.
anchors.5: Could not continue or reach an ending without restart, workaround, or external answer.

anchors.3: One loop began to feel routine but remained tolerable.
anchors.5: Repeated travel, search, popup, or action made the player want to stop.

anchors.3: At least one smile or clearly amusing reaction.
anchors.5: A memorable comic moment worth retelling.

questions: Before stopping, did the player know the correct target and action existed?
Was the full required cost, owned amount, and exact missing amount visible and understood?
After reaching the target, did the prompt, focus, or failure reason clearly indicate the next action?
With sufficient resources, did the same action succeed exactly once?
Did the shortage remain after the player deliberately prioritized the named resource without discovery delay or technical loss?
rules: Unknown target/action, hidden prompt, wrong assumed location, or late discovery is DISCOVERY.
Known target/action plus correct visible cost and an intentional but insufficient resource ledger is RESOURCE.
Late discovery caused the remaining time/resource shortage is MIXED_UX_FIRST and routes to discovery before balance.
Sufficient resources but rejected action, wrong spend, duplicated spend, or misleading state is TECHNICAL.
Never change balance from a single owner selftest or while DISCOVERY, MIXED_UX_FIRST, or TECHNICAL remains plausible.

severities.minimumEvidence: One human occurrence stops the session and build. Reproduce once only when safe; a second human sample is not required to stop.
severities.nextAction: STOP, preserve reproduction information, fix, verify, and use a new build.

conditions: physical gamepad cannot perform a keyboard-equivalent action
design-required direct-slot path absent from the build
severities.minimumEvidence: Two independent valid human sessions on one build, or one valid human session plus a deterministic same-build manual reproduction. A source-confirmed build capability gap may be filed immediately but is not a player-discovery failure.
severities.nextAction: Fix one UX/input/contract axis, keep balance values frozen, then rerun affected human checks.

severities.minimumEvidence: The same non-blocking pattern in three valid human sessions, or retain as an uncommitted note.
severities.nextAction: Queue after P0/P1; change only when it does not disturb the locked loop.

triage.balanceReviewMinimum: No balance change from owner selftest. Require the existing six-valid-session ko3/en3 external cohort, discovery/comprehension passing, and the same resource cause in at least two sessions before opening one-axis review.

stopGoRules.condition: Direct-slot entry is absent or not evaluable in the actual EXE.
stopGoRules.decision: Mark the 90-second direct-slot gate N/A for the player, record the actual path, and file a separate build-gap candidate without changing balance.

stopGoRules.condition: The actual EXE does not implement the five-day HUD and result-order contract.
stopGoRules.decision: Exclude the run from five-day balance evidence, preserve the capability reproduction, and rerun on a corrected build without changing balance.

stopGoRules.condition: One owner session finishes without P0.
stopGoRules.decision: Keep values unchanged; use the session as one diagnostic sample only.

stopGoRules.condition: A P1 meets its minimum evidence.
stopGoRules.decision: Fix the smallest responsible UX/input/contract axis and rerun on a new build.

stopGoRules.condition: A P2 pattern meets its three-human minimum.
stopGoRules.decision: Queue behind P0/P1; no immediate loop or balance change.

stopGoRules.condition: Six-session external cohort and resource-cause rules pass.
stopGoRules.decision: Open a proposal only; do not automatically change a value.
